notes.subject: שתם
notes.rationale: Root štm: 'unveiled/opened' (KJV, JPS 'open') vs 'shut/closed' (ASV, YLT, Geneva); context of v.4 and v.15-16 favors 'open', chosen here

notes.subject: tameslayt
notes.rationale: משל is a pithy模拟 oracle-saying, not ordinary speech; tameslayt approximates 'discourse/parable'

notes.subject: tiṭin-is
notes.rationale: Hebrew העין is singular 'the eye'; kab requires the plural tiṭin with possessive, and שתם takes a possessive subject not present in Hebrew

notes.subject: נאם...ונאם
notes.rationale: Doubled oracle-formula frames the introduction, a parallelism repetition kept by d awal n...awal n

translation: Yedger tameslayt-is, yenna: awal n Bilɛam, mmi-s n Beor, d awal n wemdan i d-ldin ⟨tiṭin-is⟩.
